subject: funny new error creating a gl

messages.author: dee95a14dcba222d
messages.subject: funny new error creating a gl
parts:
Hi all, I've been using this code for long time and now it is giving me errors:

gl<-gl.read.dart(
  filename="data/myreport.csv",
  ind.metafile = "data/ind_metafile.csv",
  recalc = TRUE,
  mono.rm = FALSE,
  nas = "-",
  topskip = NULL,
  lastmetric = "RepAvg",
  covfilename = NULL,
  service_row = 1,
  plate_row = 3,
  probar = FALSE,
  verbose = NULL
)
Error in gl.read.dart(filename = " data/myreport.csv",  :
  unused arguments (service_row = 1, plate_row = 3)

I removed service_row and plate_row, and creates the genlight object; however, other funny things have been happening. Am I using the right dartR version? has it had any new update?

Kind regards,
Claudia

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: funny new error creating a gl
parts:
Hi Claudia,

In the CRAN version of dartR the parameter names are: "service_row" and "plate_row". We changed the names of these parameters in the developing version of dartR to: "service.row" and "plate.row". 

To install the CRAN version of dartR:

> install.packages("dartR")

To install the the developing version of dartR:

> devtools::install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR@dev")

To check the format of the parameters of each function, you can open the function documentation by typing a question mark and the function name in the R console, for example:

> library(dartR)
> ?gl.read.dart

Cheers,
Luis
